# RoboDev Labs

> RoboDev Labs is a technology company building practical software solutions, educating and mentoring aspiring engineers, and creating proprietary software products.

- Website: https://robodevlabs.com
- Contact: robodevlabs.team@gmail.com
- Founder: Safal Bhattarai

## Areas

- Engineering Services: custom software, AI solutions, web and mobile applications, cloud architecture.
- RoboDev Academy: practical technology training, hands-on workshops, and developer mentorship.
- Product Studio: incubating proprietary technology products, starting with the Busly transit platform.

## Engineering Services

- Custom Software (/services/custom-software): web applications, internal business systems, dashboards, portals, APIs.
- AI Automation (/services/ai-automation): AI-powered workflows, integrations, assistants, document and data automation.
- SaaS & Product Development (/services/saas-product-development): MVPs, SaaS platforms, prototypes, scalable product engineering.

## RoboDev Academy

Practical workshops for students and early-career developers who want to build real things:

- AI Automation for Beginners (/academy/courses/ai-automation)
- UI/UX Design with Figma (/academy/courses/ui-ux-design-figma)
- SEO Fundamentals: Get Your Website Found (/academy/courses/seo-fundamentals)

Workshop catalog: https://robodevlabs.com/academy

## Product Studio

- Busly – Smart Route Search & Booking System (/products/busly): a smart urban bus route search and booking platform with route discovery, transfer planning, interactive maps, booking, and Khalti digital payments. Built with React, Django, Supabase PostgreSQL, and Leaflet.

Studio overview: https://robodevlabs.com/products

- Junior Backend Developer (Full-time, Engineering)
